scenario: 今天个性化赛道的主线是给排序模型更好的输入，以及更可信的离线评估。Meta 的两篇长序列工作，一篇让历史行为的 embedding 也带上用户自己的视角，一篇把多读历史和多堆层数拆开来调；另一篇讨论在曝光概率没有记录的广告系统里，怎么离线挑出最好的模型。此外还有扶持新创作者的流量模拟器、广告补贴分配的线上实验，以及经典 PageRank 在时序链接预测上打平新模型的提醒。

papers.title: PRISM: Personalized Item Representations in User History
papers.authors: Renzhi Wu, Zikun Cui, Junjie Yang, Li Sheng, Yongjun Xie, Jerry Fu, Nipun Mathur, Sri Reddy, Hong Li
papers.abstract: Sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. The same item therefore yields the same initial embedding representation, even when users have different relationships to the item. We propose personalized item representations in user history, where each item's embedding expresses its relationship to the user. Personalization becomes a property of the history inputs themselves, supplying richer evidence for later sequence modeling. We instantiate this idea with PRISM, which reuses upstream ranking computation to generate personalized item embeddings. An autoencoder jointly compresses all layer states from a user tower, a user--item tower, and same-request candidate mixing into one embedding per scored pair for downstream replay. Offline evaluation on Surface 1, a major recommendation surface at billion scale, reports an average downstream normalized entropy (NE) change of $-0.15\%$, compared with $-0.07\%$ for VISTA at similar history lengths. We further identify an empirical sequence-length scaling law: over history lengths of 26--240 events, NE gain follows a fitted power law with exponent 0.468, increasing from 0.06\% to 0.17\%. Therefore, personalized item representations in user history provide a new scaling dimension for improving recommendation quality.
papers.summary: 同一个做菜视频，对随手看看的用户是消遣，对美食博主是找灵感的素材，可推荐模型在两人的历史序列里给它的是同一个初始 embedding。PRISM 让历史里的每条行为都换成一个表达这个用户当时和这个物品关系的向量：它复用上游排序模型打分时已经算出的各层中间状态，把它们拼起来交给一个自编码器，压成每次曝光一个 embedding 存起来，之后的序列模型按时间顺序读取。在 Meta 一个十亿用户级的推荐场景上，下游模型的 NE 平均下降 0.15%，同样历史长度下另一种缓存历史摘要的做法 VISTA 只下降 0.07%，而且历史越长收益越大。==历史序列的输入本身也可以个性化==，计算成本还能摊到已有的上游排序上。

papers.title: Read More, Reason Deeper: Latent Workspaces for Long-Sequence Recommendation
papers.authors: Renzhi Wu, Li Sheng, Zikun Cui, Junjie Yang, Tai Guo, Keke Zhai, Yan Li, Jerry Fu, Nipun Mathur, Sri Reddy, Hong Li
papers.abstract: Long-sequence recommendation can improve along two axes: \emph{evidence scaling} exposes longer histories, while \emph{reasoning scaling} adds layers that interpret that evidence for a candidate. Existing models couple them: sequence encoders propagate every added event through depth, whereas one-shot selection prevents later layers from revisiting omitted evidence. We introduce the Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR), which keeps typed evidence in persistent banks and propagates a fixed-size candidate-local workspace. Each layer rereads the banks from its evolving workspace and archives compact post-interaction state, allowing history length and reasoning depth to grow independently. We compare four architectures across various history--depth configurations using evidence scaling at fixed depth, reasoning scaling at fixed 10K history, and their joint compute-efficient frontier. LWR leads all families at long histories, continues improving with reasoning compute, and converts additional training compute into quality gains at the fastest fitted rate on the joint frontier. At 10K history, it improves NE by 0.19% over HSTU while using 69.6% fewer forward GFLOP/request. It also outperforms existing baselines on two billion-scale ranking surfaces. These results show that separating addressable evidence from propagated state makes reading more and reasoning deeper independently controllable and jointly useful.
papers.summary: 长序列推荐想变强有两条路：多读历史，或者多堆几层把历史用透。现有模型把两件事绑在一起：序列编码器每多读一条行为，每层都要多算一份；先挑相关行为再建模的做法只挑一次，后面的层看不到被漏掉的行为。LWR 把历史一直放在可以随时查的存储里。每个候选物品用自己的特征初始化一小组固定数量的向量，可以看成它的草稿区，只有这组向量逐层往上传；每一层都由草稿区当前的内容生成几个查询，在完整的历史里按相关程度加权读取，读回的结果和排序特征交互后更新草稿区。这样历史长度和层数可以分开调。在 1 万条历史上，它的 NE 比 HSTU 好 0.19%，每次请求的前向计算量却少了 69.6%。==多读历史和多堆层数不必互相拖累==。

papers.title: Beyond IPS: Reliable Counterfactual Evaluation in Multi-Stage Ad Systems without Logged Propensities
papers.authors: Mohsen Malmir, Mohamed A. Radwan, Houssam Nassif, Murat Ali Bayir
papers.abstract: Offline evaluation of ad-ranking policies in multi-stage delivery systems is challenging because action propensities are often unavailable, limiting inverse propensity scoring (IPS). Reward-model-based estimators such as the Direct Method (DM) avoid propensities but can be biased when candidate policies induce impression distributions that differ from the logged data. We formalize DM-based counterfactual replay and propose mixture-weighted reward modeling, which reweights logged data toward a mixture of candidate-policy distributions using density ratios from a multiclass domain classifier. We bound each candidate's value-estimation error by overlap, cold-start, and replay terms, and derive an asymptotic rule that uses the cold-start mass to decide whether to trust offline selection or route candidates to online A/B testing. On an ads-delivery simulator and on production traffic from a large-scale CTR ranking system, the mixture-weighted reward model improves policy selection over its unweighted counterpart in both settings, with the largest gains at low overlap in simulation. Combined with a doubly robust correction, it attains the highest Top-1 accuracy in production and at low and medium overlap in simulation.
papers.summary: 广告系统上线新排序模型前要先用日志离线挑出最好的候选，但多阶段投放经过拍卖、过滤、缓存，每条曝光被选中的概率没有记录，IPS 用不了。常见替代是用一个预测点击的奖励模型给新策略打分，可新策略会把曝光推向日志里少见的广告，奖励模型在那里最不准。作者把候选策略放到历史请求上重放，训练分类器判断每条曝光更像日志里的还是某个候选出的。训练共用的奖励模型时，越像候选会出的日志曝光权重越高，只有现有策略才出的曝光权重降低。线上 CTR 排序系统的五个候选都真的跑过 A/B，真实点击率已知；在 50 份随机抽取的日志上各挑一次，挑中真正最好那个的比例从不加权的 0.36 提到 0.40。

papers.title: Floor It, Then Fill It: Simulating Creator Ecosystems for Fair Video-Content Recommendation Systems at Billion User Scale
papers.authors: Sohini Roychowdhury, Long Sha, Sunand Agarwal, Payal Kamboj, Shuyang Chen, Junlin Zhang, Scott Chen, Hui Zhang
papers.abstract: Engagement-optimized content recommendation systems exhibit a well-documented rich-get-richer dynamic that structurally disadvantages emerging creators on large-scale platforms. Evaluating debiasing interventions at scale demands faithful simulation of creator-viewer ecosystems, yet the fidelity, diversity, and validity of such simulators remain underexplored. We present a grounded user-simulation framework that models a heterogeneous population of ${\sim}42$K creators and their coupled viewer interactions over 12~weeks, and use it to evaluate equitable view-allocation policies formulated as a budgeted multi-armed bandit (MAB). The simulator captures three behavioral dimensions: (i)~\textbf{creator diversity}, modeled via a clustering approach grounded in real platform creator-level distributions; (ii)~\textbf{behavioral fidelity}, captured through coupled creator-content state machines that represent growth trajectories, engagement accumulation, and graduation dynamics; and (iii)~\textbf{population-level validity}, measured by calibration against observed platform metrics. We evaluate simulative-configurations that vary content-viewership target definitions, reward functions, and a small-creator reserve lever to maximize creator-content recommendation equity. A floor-protected per content-view-target with a view-parity-gap reward guarantees 90\% of view targets being met by creators every week, grows small-creator organic reach ${\sim}{+}33\%$ per week, and achieves high distribution stability (set of creators with funded-views Jaccard $= 0.819$). We analyze the Sim2Real gap and propose validation protocols, contributing evidence for when simulation-derived fairness conclusions can be trusted.
papers.summary: 推荐系统按互动量分配流量，大创作者越来越大，新人很难被看到。想测试扶持新人的分流策略，直接在线上试代价太高，作者于是搭了一个约 4.2 万名创作者的模拟器，创作者的构成和整体指标都按真实平台校准，在里面比较不同的流量分配方式。效果最好的是给创作者设每周的保底播放目标，分配算法把创作者离目标还差的播放量当作奖励，于是差得越多的小创作者越先拿到扶持流量。这样每周有 90% 的保底目标按时完成，小创作者的自然流量每周增长约 33%。作者也专门讨论了模拟器得出的公平结论什么时候可信。

papers.title: Revisiting Temporal Link Prediction through Structural Proximity
papers.authors: Yuzhang Fei, Yanping Zheng, Lu Yi, Zhewei Wei
papers.abstract: Existing temporal link prediction methods typically rely on learned temporal representations to capture evolving interaction patterns. In this paper, we show that a classical structural proximity measure can match or outperform these methods without training or learned temporal sequence modeling. We revisit Personalized PageRank (PPR) on historical interaction graphs, using simple sliding-window retention or exponential time decay. Surprisingly, across 14 datasets, Time-decay PPR ranks first on nine and second on four among the compared methods, including datasets with few repeated edges. To understand this result, we examine the historical paths connecting source nodes to previously unseen destinations. We find that such paths contain useful predictive information, and that PPR outperforms a strong neural baseline on queries where historical structure clearly distinguishes the true destination from negative candidates. These results show that strong performance on current benchmarks does not necessarily require complex temporal models. More fundamentally, they raise the question of how much predictive value learned temporal modeling adds beyond historical structural proximity. Our findings motivate reassessing progress in temporal link prediction with strong classical baselines.
papers.summary: 时序链接预测要猜接下来谁会和谁发生交互，这几年的新方法大多在学越来越复杂的时序表示，但一个经典方法就能打平甚至超过它们。作者把个性化 PageRank 直接放到历史交互图上，只加一个滑动窗口或者让旧边的权重随时间衰减，完全不需要训练。在 14 个数据集上，带时间衰减的版本有 9 个排第一、4 个排第二，连很少出现重复边的数据集也是如此。原因是历史图里连向新目标的路径本身就带着很强的信号。==现有基准可能高估了复杂时序模型的价值==，评估新方法时应该把这类经典基线放进对比。

papers.title: CASH: A Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for Advertiser Subsidy Allocation
papers.authors: Minmao Wang, Huihuang Lin, Likang Wu, Hongke Zhao, Shijie Yi, Fei Pan
papers.abstract: Advertising platforms subsidize advertisers through billing discounts, and Advertiser Subsidy Allocation (ASA) chooses a subsidy level for every account to maximize total discounted revenue under a platform-wide subsidy-rate constraint. In practice, operators configure these subsidies from business rules, advertiser tiers and operating goals. Such configuration draws on rich business experience, yet as the advertiser base grows, tier-level policies can neither resolve how individual accounts respond across subsidy levels nor allocate a shared budget at the granularity of single accounts. We propose CASH, a Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for ASA. CASH pairs a knowledge-guided large language model (LLM) with a data-driven numerical response model, learns from realized outcomes where each is locally reliable across accounts and subsidy levels, and turns this reliability into explicit capability licenses that govern source selection, agent review and budget allocation. Its Expected Policy Coverage Gain (EPCG) directs a limited feedback budget toward evidence expected to expand high-value reliable coverage, and the resulting feedback further improves the numerical model and updates capability estimates. In a one-month online experiment with CASH serving 60% of a large-scale advertising platform's traffic, CASH raises revenue per account by 15.35% and ADVV by 19.86% over Control at an essentially unchanged subsidy rate, with further gains in revenue quality, LTV and retention.
papers.summary: 广告平台会给广告主打折补贴，通常由运营按广告主分层定规则，但每个账户在不同补贴力度下怎么反应，分层规则管不到。CASH 要预估每个账户在每档补贴下能带来多少收入，同时用两种方式来估：一个带业务知识的大模型，一个从历史数据学出来的数值模型。它拿已经出结果的账户算两者各自的预测误差，再学一个模型预估两者在每类账户、每档补贴上会错多少，只有误差小的那一方才被允许参与决定和分预算。在覆盖平台 60% 流量、为期一个月的线上实验里，补贴率基本不变，平台从每个账户拿到的收入提高 15.35%，留存等长期指标也有提升。

papers.title: Bridging Semantics and Structure: A Theoretically Grounded Framework for Link Prediction on TAGs
papers.authors: Chen Shao, Ruirui Wang, Tobias Kafer, Danai Koutra
papers.abstract: Link prediction on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is a fundamental problem with applications in knowledge discovery, recommendation and beyond. Recent progress has highlighted the promise of combining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Language Models (LMs) in order to leverage the complementary structural and semantic signals. However, due to the distinct inductive biases of GNNs and LMs, the design of an optimal fusion strategy remains an open research question. In this work, we present Bridge-LP, an intuitive, simple, efficient and theoretically grounded framework that unifies graph and language representations. It is built around three theoretically-justified design components: (D1) jumping connection of textual proximity, which enables robust LM training; (D2) compressed embedding, which encodes neighborhood information long exploited by classical link prediction heuristics, thereby enriching structural signals in a learnable way; and (D3) cache embedding training strategy, which reduces computational complexity. Together, these mechanisms establish an end-to-end cross-modal framework that scales to large graphs while capturing richer graph-text interactions. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation, comparing against 40 existing models across 9 diverse datasets. Experiments show that Bridge-LP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, delivering up to a 43.06% improvement in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and setting a new benchmark for language-graph integration.
papers.summary: 在带文本的图上做链接预测，比如预测两篇论文会不会互相引用，常见做法是把语言模型和 GNN 拼起来，但两者到底怎么融合一直没有定论。Bridge-LP 的做法比较朴素：让语言模型输出的文本 embedding 绕过 GNN 的各层，直接并入最终用来打分的节点 embedding，这样损失的梯度能直接传回语言模型，训练更稳；另外，训练时只为当前这批边涉及的节点重新编码文本，其余节点先用缓存的旧 embedding，省下大量算力。作者在 9 个数据集上和 40 个已有模型做了比较，在 Cora 上 MRR 比最强基线高 43.06%。这两个设计都不贵，做图推荐的团队可以单独拿来试。

papers.title: DeepCommerceRec: a graph- and sequence-aware deep learning recommender system with cold-start adaptation for large-scale e-commerce platforms
papers.authors: Kumbham Bhargavi, Soanpet Sree Lakshmi, B. Sreenivasu, M. Shanthi, Kiran Kumar Reddy Penubaka, B. Nagadivya
papers.abstract:
For large-scale e-commerce, modelling long-term collaborative preferences, short-term behavioural intent, and sparse interactions needs to be done simultaneously. Existing graph-based methods can represent structural user–item relationships well, while sequential models capture the temporal evolution of user behaviour; however, many methods cannot adaptively coordinate these complementary signals, and few incorporate cold-start handling within the same ranking framework.
To overcome this drawback, the authors propose a graph- and sequence-aware deep learning framework (DeepCommerceRec) that integrates cold-start adaptation (CSA) and context-conditioned fusion (CCF). This structure uses a dual-encoder design: heterogeneous graph representation learning to learn structural user representations and sequential behavioural modelling to learn temporal user representations.
These are fused adaptively, depending on interaction availability, sequence length, behavioural recency, and cold-user/cold-item status. In a sparse setting, we build metadata- and neighbourhood-aware representations for cold items and leverage few-shot recent interactions to adapt cold-user representations. Experiments on three public e-commerce datasets show that DeepCommerceRec outperforms traditional, sequential, graph-based, and more recent hybrid baselines on HR@10, NDCG@10, and MRR.
Repeated runs and statistical analysis confirm that the observed improvements are robust, and evaluation under mixed warm–cold and cold-start settings shows improved ranking performance in sparse interaction scenarios. Ablation and sensitivity analyses further validate the contributions and stability of the proposed components. These gains are demonstrated via computational evaluation under the tested benchmark conditions with acceptable inference overhead.
In summary, DeepCommerceRec offers a single framework for context-adaptive structural–temporal recommendation and incorporates cold-user and cold-item treatment.
papers.summary: 电商推荐要同时处理三件事：长期的协同偏好、短期的购买意图，以及新用户和新商品几乎没有交互。DeepCommerceRec 用两个编码器分开学：一个在异构图上学用户和商品之间的结构关系，一个在行为序列上学兴趣随时间的变化，一个小 MLP 读入两边的向量和交互次数、是否冷启动等信息，逐维输出 0 到 1 之间的比重来混合两边。新用户的序列表示换成他最近几次交互商品的加权汇总，越近权重越大。作者在 Amazon、YooChoose、RetailRocket 三个公开数据集上报告 HR@10、NDCG@10 和 MRR 都超过各类基线。方法主要是已有部件的组合，对实际系统最有参考价值的是按冷热程度调整融合权重这一点。

papers.title: Hidden Disparities in Ranking: Category-Aware Fairness via Distributional Stability
papers.authors: Gayane Taturyan, Charlotte Laclau, Stephan Clémençon
papers.abstract: We study the problem of fair ranking in recommender systems. We provide a formal probabilistic framework in which ranking policies are distributions over permutations, and the utility of a user is the exposure given to the items they interact with, relative to that of an ideal ranking. We consider utility parity across user groups, as well as its category-aware refinement, conditional utility parity, which requires parity within each category of items. Following a recent view of fairness as distributional stability, we show that both criteria are equivalent to the stability of the utility under changes in the composition of user groups. Optimizing over mixtures of ranking policies leads to a second-order cone program, for which we provide generalization bounds. A numerical study validates our theoretical findings.
papers.summary: 检查排序是否公平，常见做法是看不同用户群体拿到的效用平均下来是否相等，但这会把问题盖住。作者模拟了一个招聘平台：历史数据里女性对管理岗、男性对行政岗的兴趣被漏记，于是女性在管理岗、男性在行政岗上都被少推，可两边的差距一抵消，总体差距接近零。作者因此要求在每个岗位类别内部分别做到群体间效用相等。他们证明这等价于不管两个群体在用户里各占多少比例，全体用户的平均效用都不变。最后从几个现成排序策略的混合里找满足约束、效用最高的那个，并在 MovieLens-1M 上做了验证。==只看总体公平指标，可能看不到类别内部的偏差==。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Under Runtime Confounding: Policy Learning and Off-Policy Evaluation
papers.authors: Raphael Kim, Michele Santacatterina, Ramin Zabih, Keith Barnatchez
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to train robust, adaptable systems across healthcare, e-commerce, and robotics. In these settings, legal, ethical, or logistical concerns may preclude certain key variables that drive decisions from being collected during deployment time. This gives rise to a setting known as runtime confounding: the logged data hold full observability, but deployment time lacks knowledge of certain variables, known as runtime confounders. Unlike single timepoint and non-adaptive settings, runtime confounding under reinforcement learning has the potential to propagate over time, as earlier decisions affect future states, observations, and action assignments, leading to biased learning. We address these problems with three contributions: we (1) develop policy learning algorithms under runtime-confounding, (2) develop semi-parametric efficient off-policy estimation procedures, and (3) provide diagnostics for understanding the price of runtime confounding.
papers.summary: 训练时日志里能看到的变量，上线时不一定能用。比如临床决策工具训练时有患者的社会经济信息，部署时为了防止歧视却不能把它作为输入。作者把这种日志完整、部署受限的情况叫运行时混杂。放到强化学习里问题更麻烦，因为前一步的决策会影响后面的状态和动作，偏差会一路累积。作者给出只用部署时可得变量的策略学习算法，以及一个双重稳健的离线评估方法，能给出有效的置信区间；还给出一个检验，算出不让用这些变量到底要损失多少回报。推荐和广告里因为隐私或合规不能在线上使用、但日志里有的特征，也是同一类问题。
